newsitem.title: USA: Con Ed shuts Indian Pt 2 nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: Con Ed shuts Indian Pt 2 nuclear plant.

text.p: Consolidated Edison Co of New York (Con Ed) shut its 975 megawatt (MW) Indian Point 2 nuclear power plant Sunday to correct problems with a feedwater valve, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday.
The plant, at the Indian Point facility along the Hudson River in upstate New York, is expected to restart Monday, NRC said in its daily status report.
Number 2, one of three nuclear units at Indian Point, was operating at full power on Friday.
The adjacent Indian Point 3, rated at 965 MW, has been shut since January 18 for repairs to its feedwater heaters and is likely to be down until mid-February.
The number 3 unit is operated by New York Power Authority.
